part 1a.defaultText:
Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. 

Would you like some directions?

responses.defaultText: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.

part 2a.defaultText: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless!

responses.defaultText: Thanks! I'm off to explore now.
